Pull WDID structure metadata for spatial layers

```{r}
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

source("scripts/get_structures.R")

structure_test <- get_structures(wdid = "0404634")

structures_meta <- get_structures_many(wdids = structures$wdid)

structures_joined <- structures %>% 
  left_join(structures_meta, by = "wdid") %>% 
  drop_na(latitude, longitude)

# write.csv(structures_joined, "data/structures.csv", row.names = FALSE)

structures_sf <- structures_joined %>%
st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>% select(wdid, official_name = name.y, destination_basin ,structure_type, division, water_district, county, geometry, latitude, longitude)

st_write(structures_sf, "shiny_app/data/structures.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```

basin layers 
```{r}
library(rmapshaper)
library(AOI)

co_basin <- st_read("data/colorado") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE) 
sp_basin <- st_read("data/southplatte") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
sj_basin <- st_read("data/sanjuan") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
rg_basin <- st_read("data/riogrande") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
dl_basin <- st_read("data/dolores") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
ak_basin <- st_read("data/arkansas") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
np_basin <- st_read("data/northplatte") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)
yp_basin <- st_read("data/yampa") %>% st_transform(4326) %>% ms_simplify(keep = 0.10, keep_shapes = TRUE)

co_state <- aoi_get(state = "CO") %>% st_transform(4326)

basins <- bind_rows(
  co_basin %>% mutate(basin = "Colorado"),
  sp_basin %>% mutate(basin = "South Platte"),
  sj_basin %>% mutate(basin = "San Juan"),
  rg_basin %>% mutate(basin = "Rio Grande"),
  dl_basin %>% mutate(basin = "Dolores"),
  ak_basin %>% mutate(basin = "Arkansas"),
  np_basin %>% mutate(basin = "North Platte"),
  yp_basin %>% mutate(basin = "Yampa/White")
) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_intersection(co_state)

st_write(basins, "shiny_app/data/basins.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dataRetrieval)
source("scripts/fetch_telemetry.R")

get_streamflow <- function(gage_id, start_date = Sys.Date() -1, end_date = Sys.Date()) {
  
  if (gage_id %in% stream_gages$id[stream_gages$type == "USGS"]) {
    data <- read_waterdata_daily(monitoring_location_id =  gage_id,
                              parameter_code = "00060",
                              time = start_date) %>% 
  renameNWISColumns()
    
    data <- data %>%
      select(date = time, flow_cfs = value, id = monitoring_location_id)
    
  } else if (gage_id %in% stream_gages$id[stream_gages$type == "CDSS"]) {
    data <- fetch_yesterday_many(wdid = gage_id, target_date = start_date)
    data <- data %>%
      select(date = date, flow_cfs = discharge_cfs, id = wdid)
    
  } else {
    stop("Unknown gage ID")
  }
  
  return(data)
}

yesterday_flows <- bind_rows(lapply(stream_gages$id, function(gage_id) {
  get_streamflow(gage_id)
}))
```


```{r}

get_usgs_flows <- function(gage_ids, start_date, end_date) {
  read_waterdata_daily(
    monitoring_location_id = gage_ids,        
    parameter_code = "00060",
    time = c(start_date, end_date)
  ) %>%
    renameNWISColumns() %>%
    select(date = time, flow_cfs = value, id = monitoring_location_id)
}

get_cdss_flows <- function(gage_ids, start_date) {
  fetch_yesterday_many(wdids = gage_ids, target_date = start_date) %>%
    select(date = date, flow_cfs = discharge_cfs, id = wdid)
}

get_all_flows <- function(stream_gages, start_date = Sys.Date() - 1) {
  usgs_ids <- stream_gages$id[stream_gages$type == "USGS"]
  cdss_ids <- stream_gages$id[stream_gages$type == "CDSS"]

  bind_rows(
    if (length(usgs_ids) > 0) get_usgs_flows(usgs_ids, start_date),
    if (length(cdss_ids) > 0) get_cdss_flows(cdss_ids, start_date)
  )
}

yesterday_flows <- get_all_flows(stream_gages)

yesterday_flows <- yesterday_flows %>% 
  left_join(stream_gages, by = "id")

```

Manually building out the stream backfill 

```{r}
library(skimr)
usgs_hist <- get_usgs_flows(gage_ids = stream_gages$id[stream_gages$type == "USGS"], start_date = "1999-10-01", end_date = "2025-09-30")

# skim(usgs_hist)

fetch_sw_daily <- function(abbrev, start_date, end_date) {
  resp <- request("https://dwr.state.co.us/Rest/GET/api/v2") %>%
    req_url_path_append("surfacewater/surfacewatertsday") %>%
    req_url_query(
      format        = "json",
      abbrev        = abbrev,
      `min-measDate` = format(as.Date(start_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
      `max-measDate` = format(as.Date(end_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
      pageSize      = 50000,
      apiKey        = api_key
    ) %>%
    req_perform()

  rows <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)$ResultList
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)

  bind_rows(lapply(rows, function(r) {
    tibble(
      date     = as.Date(substr(r$measDate, 1, 10)),
      flow_cfs = as.numeric(r$value %||% NA),
      abbrev   = abbrev
    )
  }))
}

cdss_riolobco <- fetch_sw_daily(abbrev = "RIOLOBCO", start_date = "1999-10-01", end_date = "2025-09-30")  

cdss_onejurco <- fetch_sw_daily(abbrev = "ONEJURCO", start_date = "1999-10-01", end_date = "2025-09-30")

cdss_hist <- bind_rows(cdss_riolobco, cdss_onejurco) %>% 
  mutate(id = as.character(case_when(
    abbrev == "RIOLOBCO" ~ "2202019",
    abbrev == "ONEJURCO" ~ "6402896",
  ))) 

streamflow_hist <- usgs_hist %>% 
  mutate(abbrev = NA) %>% 
  bind_rows(cdss_hist) %>% 
  left_join(stream_gages, by = "id") %>% 
  select(-cdss_abbrev)

```
Compute daily normals, smoothed to a 

```{r}
library(lubridate)

streamflow_hist_doy <- streamflow_hist %>% 
  mutate(doy = yday(date)) %>% 
  drop_na(flow_cfs) %>% 
  group_by(doy, id) %>% 
  summarise(
      n_obs    = n(),
      p25_cfs  = quantile(flow_cfs, 0.25),
      p50_cfs  = quantile(flow_cfs, 0.50),
      p75_cfs  = quantile(flow_cfs, 0.75),
      mean_cfs = mean(flow_cfs),
      .groups  = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(stream_gages, by = "id")

write_parquet(streamflow_hist_doy, "local_data/streamflow_normals.parquet")

```

daily backfill 
```{r}
source("scripts/fetch_telemetry.R")
source("scripts/fetch_streamflow.R")
library(arrow); library(dplyr); library(readr)


structures   <- read_csv("data/structures.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stream_gages <- read_csv("data/stream_gages.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-10-01"), Sys.Date() - 1, by = "day")

for (d in dates) {
  d <- as.Date(d, origin = "1970-01-01")
  message("===== ", d, " =====")
  
  div <- fetch_yesterday_many(structures$wdid, target_date = d)
  if (nrow(div) > 0) {
    write_parquet(div, sprintf("local_data/daily_diversions_%s.parquet", d))
  }
  
  flow <- fetch_streamflow_yesterday(stream_gages, target_date = d)
  if (nrow(flow) > 0) {
    write_parquet(flow, sprintf("local_data/daily_flows_%s.parquet", d))
  }
}
```

```{r}
structures <- read_csv("data/structures.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

lookup_station <- function(wdid) {
  resp <- request("https://dwr.state.co.us/Rest/GET/api/v2") %>%
    req_url_path_append("telemetrystations/telemetrystation") %>%
    req_url_query(format = "json", wdid = wdid) %>%
    req_perform()
  
  stations <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)$ResultList
  if (length(stations) == 0) {
    return(tibble(abbrev = NA_character_, parameter = NA_character_))
  }
  s <- stations[[1]]
  tibble(
    abbrev    = s$abbrev,
    parameter = s$parameter %||% "DISCHRG"
  )
}

# Loop, with progress and politeness pauses
station_info <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(structures)), function(i) {
  w <- structures$wdid[i]
  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s", i, nrow(structures), w))
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
  tryCatch(lookup_station(w), error = function(e) {
    message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    tibble(abbrev = NA_character_, parameter = NA_character_)
  })
}))

# Combine and save
structures_updated <- bind_cols(structures, station_info)
write_csv(structures_updated, "data/structures.csv")

```

Daily data back fill diversions 

```{r}

setwd("/Users/nickpenzel/github/transbasin_div")

fetch_telemetry_range <- function(wdid, abbrev, parameter, start_date, end_date) {
  resp <- request("https://dwr.state.co.us/Rest/GET/api/v2") %>%
    req_url_path_append("telemetrystations/telemetrytimeseriesday") %>%
    req_url_query(
      format         = "json",
      abbrev         = abbrev,
      parameter      = parameter,
      `min-measDate` = format(as.Date(start_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
      `max-measDate` = format(as.Date(end_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
      pageSize       = 50000,
      apiKey         = api_key
    ) %>%
    req_perform()
  
  rows <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)$ResultList
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  bind_rows(lapply(rows, function(r) {
    tibble(
      wdid          = wdid,
      date          = as.Date(substr(r$measDate, 1, 10)),
      discharge_cfs = as.numeric(r$measValue %||% NA),
      abbrev        = abbrev,
      parameter     = parameter
    )
  }))
}

test <- fetch_telemetry_range("0404634", "ADATUNCO", "DISCHRG", start_date = start, end_date = end)

structures <- read_csv("data/structures.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  drop_na(abbrev)

start <- Sys.Date() - 90
end   <- Sys.Date() - 1

# Fetch all structures over the full range
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(structures)), function(i) {
  s <- structures[i, ]
  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s", i, nrow(structures), s$wdid))
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
  tryCatch(
    fetch_telemetry_range(s$wdid, s$abbrev, s$parameter, start, end),
    error = function(e) { message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }
  )
}))


# Split into per-day Parquets to match the daily Action's output layout
for (d in unique(all_data$date)) {
  d <- as.Date(d, origin = "1970-01-01")
  day_data <- all_data %>% filter(date == d)
  path <- sprintf("local_data/daily_diversions_%s.parquet", d)
  if (!file.exists(path)) write_parquet(day_data, path)
}
usethis::edit_r_environ(
  
)
```
